    SnacksPete's fantasy draft nachosCorn chips with chorizo, beans, cheddar, guacamole and sour creamHow to make it2 chorizo sausages400g tin refried beansground cumin, to taste300g corn chips200g cheddar2 avocados1 lime1 bunch coriander150g sour cream1 jar pickled jalapeños2 spring onionsFry the diced chorizo until crisp.Warm the refried beans with the cumin.Spread the corn chips on a big tray, spoon over the beans and chorizo and cover with the grated cheddar.Bake at 200°C for 10 minutes.Mash the avocados with lime, salt and coriander.Top the nachos with guacamole, the sour cream, pickled jalapeños and spring onion.Sadie's chicken pox popcorn chickenCrispy chicken bites soaked in dill pickle brine, pickle ranch dipHow to make it600g chicken thigh fillets1 jar dill pickles1 egg100ml buttermilk150g plain flourpaprika, to taste2 L vegetable oildried dill, to taste100g sour cream2 tbsp mayonnaiseCut the chicken thigh into bite-sized pieces and soak in the dill pickle brine for 2 hours.Drain, dip in the beaten egg with the buttermilk, then the plain flour mixed with the paprika and salt.Fry in the vegetable oil at 175°C for 4 to 5 minutes until crisp and toss with dried dill and salt.Mix the sour cream, the mayo, the chopped pickles and dill for dipping.Loaded potato skins with sour creamFuel for the Flesh of the Stars website.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.Hot FoodLA Thai green chicken curryCoconut green curry and rice. Alison's on with James Franco in the morningHow to make it1 1/2 cups jasmine rice3 tbsp green curry paste400ml coconut milk800g chicken thigh fillets100ml chicken stock4 makrut lime leavesfish sauce, to tastepalm sugar, to taste150g snake beans1 bunch Thai basil1 red chilliCook the jasmine rice.Fry the green curry paste in the thick top of the coconut milk until fragrant.Add the sliced chicken thigh and stir 3 minutes.Pour in the rest of the coconut milk, the stock, the torn makrut lime leaves, the fish sauce and the palm sugar.Simmer 12 minutes, adding the snake beans for the last 5.Stir in Thai basil and serve with rice and sliced chilli.Roommates' pepperoni and hot honey pizzaPepperoni, jalapeños and mozzarella on a crisp base, chilli honey and rocket on topHow to make it1kg pizza dough250g tomato passata2 garlic cloves, crushed1 tsp dried oregano300g mozzarella, grated150g sliced pepperoni1 jar pickled jalapeños2 tbsp honey1 tsp chilli flakes60g rocket40g parmesanHeat the oven as high as it goes with two trays inside.Mix the passata with the garlic, oregano and a pinch of salt.Stretch the dough into 4 bases on baking paper, spread with the sauce and top with the mozzarella, pepperoni and jalapeños.Slide onto the hot trays and bake 8 to 10 minutes until blistered, two at a time.Warm the honey with the chilli flakes, drizzle over and finish with rocket and shaved parmesan.Ices and SweetsBirthday party lemon cupcakesLemon and raspberry. Debbie and Pete make up at the partyHow to make it325g butter150g caster sugar1 lemon2 eggs200g self-raising flour150ml milk120g raspberry jam400g icing sugarpink and blue food colouring, to tastefreeze-dried raspberries, to taste12 cupcake casesHeat the oven to 175°C.Beat the butter and the caster sugar with lemon zest, add the eggs, then the self-raising flour and the milk.Bake in the cases for 18 minutes and cool.Fill each centre with raspberry jam.Beat the butter with the icing sugar and the milk, split in two and tint pale pink and pale blue.Pipe on and crumble over freeze-dried raspberries.Cold DrinksBouncer's verdict mocktailGrape juice, lime, soda water and mint over ice, no alcoholHow to make it600ml grape juice2 limes500ml soda water1 bunch mintFill the glasses with ice, add the grape juice and a squeeze of lime to each and top with soda water and mint.Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.Morning sickness ginger aleWhat Alison could have used on the Franco interview.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
